answer: Filling 172 aliases as a result needs 172 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the crystal record and indexed in the ridge history, the tide audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
